purpose: A four-file MR (a TTL cache with a race, its handler, a job, a web client) beside a secret and a vendored file: OCR selects the four, an LLM grouping makes three groups, the cache group gets a plan, its round-1 comments are placed, one re-located by the LLM, one removed by the filter, round 2 adds a finding, and the review is posted as inline comments under a sticky summary. Run twice on the same MR, the summary is edited, not duplicated.

mr.title: Add a TTL cache for the request handlers
mr.description: Caches lookups for five minutes; a nightly job purges expired entries.
